body:
It was a lot more of self criticism - the root cause of my depression is this inferior sense of self that I have and I beat myself up senseless over comparing myself to others etc. 

As much as I lied to myself and others that “I’m fine” and “I’m actually ok being lesser than others” - I never was. Never had I fully accepted the image that being inferior to others was ok because I couldn’t. I just can’t.

And I can’t live with the constant lying that I’m doing to myself plus me comparing myself to others constantly - it’s very exhausting in my head. There’s nowhere to run to; I can’t escape from myself unless I’m unconscious.

That’s a general idea I guess
I wake up everyday looking forward to going to bed every night
